measurement_notes: Per-stage independent quantiles cannot be added. Trace-only timings are separate from uninstrumented formal comparisons.
Pad probes observe original buffers without mapping, copying or adding a pipeline element; CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID is only the callback/streaming thread, not aggregate CPU across encoder workers.
Actual conversion/codec stages are uniquely associated with the final displayed response by nesting inside its sole in-flight Encoder call; frame IDs are retained in codec_correlations.
Formal Agent binaries have no Linux instrumentation: unknown first readback/I420 IDs remain null. The X11 RGB path does not collect separate I420 buffer IDs.
A/B order old,new,new,old,new,old,old,new. Each round has 2 key and 2 click warmups followed by 30 of each, 240 formal responses per variant; all spikes kept.
The two 480-response trials use different time windows and must be compared within their own baseline, not against historical 75 ms or against each other.
No perf/strace, compilation or gates ran concurrently with formal sampling. Existing source applications and workload were left running; per-round load is preserved.
RTT samples bracket trials and are not synchronized one-way network measurements. The mixed residual is not pure network latency.
Original installed binary was never replaced or restarted. Only temporary isolated Agents/network services were switched, then stopped with private authorization/identity copies removed.

Direct four-thread conversion changed chroma pixels for some geometries; aligned partitions corrected pixel/fidelity gates, but formal E2E still did not improve. Both aligned parallel conversion and batch-padding experiments were reverted.

raw_archive.redaction: No video payloads, user application contents, clipboard, authentication or pairing secrets; session IDs aliased; process memory pointers removed after correlation.
